gates.name: Temporal integrity (no look-ahead)
gates.rule: Every feature for a game uses only earlier games of the same season (shift-by-one). Perturbation test: adding 40 points to a game's own result must leave that game's features unchanged (team test) and adding 30 points to a player's box score must leave that player-game's features unchanged (player test), while later games change.

gates.name: Sample size
gates.rule: Holdout must contain at least 1,000 settled bets (singles/props) or 300 parlays. Underpowered results cannot earn the top tier.

gates.name: Beats the market proxy
gates.rule: Mean absolute error of the strategy's line must be lower than the market-proxy line (50/50 season-to-date/recency blend) on all holdout rows, one-sided p < 0.05 with date-clustered standard errors.

gates.name: Statistical significance after multiple testing
gates.rule: Hit rate must exceed the 52.38% break-even implied by an ASSUMED −110 price (1/1.9091) with Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05 across ALL registered trials (27 single/prop trials). Parlay types are tested on ROI > 0 with Holm across the parlay types that could be built. Standard errors are clustered by game date.

gates.name: Repeatability (luck removal)
gates.rule: Hit rate > 50% in at least 3 of the 4 holdout seasons, > 50% in the dev sample at the same threshold, and > 50% in both alternating-week halves of the holdout.

gates.name: Threshold robustness
gates.rule: Hit rate > 50% at all three pre-registered edge thresholds (top 50%, 25%, 10% of dev |edge|), so the result does not hinge on one cut-off.

gates.name: No directional bias
gates.rule: Share of Over/Home sides must stay within 35%–65%, and the hit rate must beat a directional null (each season's own over-rate) with p < 0.05 — a strategy cannot win by just always leaning one way.

gates.name: Parlay correlation screen
gates.rule: Average pairwise correlation between leg outcomes must satisfy |ρ| ≤ 0.10, because the ASSUMED independent-leg price would otherwise be mispriced (sportsbooks reprice correlated legs).

gates.name: Availability check
gates.rule: Props are voided if the player does not play (as books do). For live use, the official NBA Injury Report must be checked: status due 5 p.m. local the day before a game; 1 p.m. local on the second night of a back-to-back; updated continually on game day. This check is NOT automated in the backtest (historical reports not collected).

gates.name: Placebo calibration (system)
gates.rule: Random-side strategies placed on identical bet sets must pass the significance gate no more often than 5% of the time (observed: 0 of 2,700).

gates.name: Prospective replication
gates.rule: Strategy must replicate on games played AFTER the code and thresholds were frozen. Not possible with the available dataset (ends 2023-24); this is why the highest tier is labeled "Provisional".
